Summary:
This is the personal site of Arjun Kuttikkat, founder of Edgaze. It contains project pages, blog posts, an about page, a newsletter page, and a terminal-style interactive route. The most useful sources for factual retrieval are the blog articles, project pages, and sitemap/feed URLs listed below.

Crawl policy:
- Public site content may be indexed, summarized, and cited.
- Prefer canonical URLs when available.
- Prefer the RSS feed and sitemap for discovery.
